units.evidence: Current college hosts business and sustainability programs, including MBA Sustainability Management. decisions.reason: Imported phrase is not verified as a department. Current Sustainability Management is an MBA concentration; official college host and substantial operations/supply-chain faculty remit verified independently.

sources.note: Current Professor of Sustainability explicitly in Falk college, teaching operations and supply-chain management and researching sustainable supply-chain systems.
Current three-college structure and university identity.
Full current college name and ELM acronym, business/sustainability programs and Department of Business Systems accreditation.
